generator: ImageGen with the actual existing crew portrait as identity reference
purpose: Known person-bound discovery stories gain recognizable character illustrations rather than a generic environment.
style: Existing StavangerZ painterly realism, fixed crew faces/hair/costume, sea-green/slate/olive shadows and natural amber window light.
selectionContract: Only already-public story IDs ingrid-route-notes, leila-care-notes and marius-return-notes, plus the existing Tor kind. Do not render as a catalog of undiscovered stories or infer a person is currently alive from the illustration.
presentation: Fictional reusable character-story or remembered-story illustration across clue/choice/resolved/lost stages. The caption, actual choices and authoritative save determine what happened.

cropReview.method: Technical previews of final encoded assets, not a substitute for integrated browser verification.
cropReview.result: All four recognizable faces remained visible; no crop became only hands or a generic room.

limits: No new crew face or dynamic equipment rendering. Established portrait files are untouched.
Neutral interiors have no identifiable POI, sea, mountain or real building.
No image asserts chosen supplies, medical treatment, repaired machinery, visible injury/death, actual names from a document or stage-specific reward.
The illustration is not a current-camera snapshot and must not become evidence that a lost/dead person is still alive.
